name: breachledger
description: A structured public record of disclosed U.S. data breaches, with a remediation engine and litigation tracking. Every published fact traces to a citable government or court source.

scripts.db:seed: node packages/schema/seed/load.js --out .wrangler/tmp-seed.sql && wrangler d1 execute breachledger --local --file .wrangler/tmp-seed.sql
scripts.db:seed:remote: node packages/schema/seed/load.js --out .wrangler/tmp-seed.sql && wrangler d1 execute breachledger --remote --file .wrangler/tmp-seed.sql
scripts.db:verify: wrangler d1 execute breachledger --local --command "SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM data_classes) AS data_classes, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM state_rights) AS state_rights, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM remediation_modules) AS remediation_modules, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM breaches) AS breaches, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sources) AS sources, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM litigation) AS litigation"
scripts.db:reset: rm -rf .wrangler/state && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
